caption: The drawing depicts a single round object that appears to be a strainer or sieve, rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The main object is a circular vessel with a flat base, perforated with a pattern of evenly spaced holes radiating outward from the center in a starburst arrangement. Attached to the top of the vessel is a decorative, double-handled structure with curved cutouts, and at the bottom edge, there is a small projecting tab or support. In the upper right corner of the image, a smaller, inset drawing shows a thin side view of the same object, also outlined in pencil, illustrating the profile and proportions, particularly the handle and the shallow depth of the vessel. The shading is gray and monochrome throughout the image, and the main drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border. There is a signature, "C. Heaton," located in the lower right area inside the main rectangular border.
title: Silver Punch Strainer
